title: LLM invocation token/cost budget policy
description: Machine-readable marker list and per-workflow budget requirements read by scripts/scan_workflow_llm_budget.py. additionalProperties is false throughout so a typo'd key fails loud instead of being silently ignored. The 'at least one of max_tokens_per_run / max_cost_usd_per_run' rule is not expressible in this schema subset (no oneOf/anyOf); it is enforced as a bespoke check in the scanner itself, same class as scan_ssot_schema.py's kind/script XOR rule. Refs #2269.

schema_version.description: Integer schema version; 1 is the initial shape.

tracking_issue.description: Issue number that introduced this policy file.

markers.description: Substrings that identify an LLM-invoking workflow step.

pattern.description: A literal substring matched against each logical workflow-YAML line.

budgets.description: Per-workflow budget declarations. May be empty when no workflow matches a marker.

max_tokens_per_run.description: Maximum tokens permitted in a single run. At least one of this or max_cost_usd_per_run is required (enforced by the scanner, not this schema).

max_cost_usd_per_run.description: Maximum USD cost permitted in a single run. At least one of this or max_tokens_per_run is required (enforced by the scanner, not this schema).

max_runs_per_day.description: Maximum number of runs permitted per day.

max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries permitted per run.
